name: Mini Paint

events.Click:
# Begin a drawing operation at the mouse position.
paint_start(self, event)

props.text: Drag on the canvas to draw. Eraser uses white strokes.

events.Click:
# Handle this control in the visual project.
paint_color(self, 'black')

# Handle this control in the visual project.
paint_color(self, '#b42318')

# Handle this control in the visual project.
paint_color(self, '#175cd3')

# Handle this control in the visual project.
paint_clear(self)

# Handle this control in the visual project.
paint_export(self)

startup:
# Motion/release bindings complement the designer's click event.
self.paint_color = "black"
self.paint_last = None
self.paint_shape = None
self.ToolChoice.set("Brush")
self.StrokeScale.set(4)
self.PaintCanvas.bind("<B1-Motion>", lambda event: paint_drag(self, event))
self.PaintCanvas.bind("<ButtonRelease-1>", lambda event: paint_end(self, event))
self.Form1.deiconify()
